name: Verify a repair outcome by histology and validated scar scales
description: Confirm after repair whether native architecture was restored, using biopsy histology and validated observer or patient scar scales, and detect late failure.

grade.note: Biopsy histology and validated scar scales (POSAS, Vancouver) are the accepted endpoints of the trials cited on this map (Ferguson 2009; McCollum 2011). Verification is destructive or observational and does not confirm cell-level state.

provenance.method: manual reasoning from the cited sources' abstracts (PubMed) and Crossref metadata, checked 2026-09-11; no source opened at figure level
